newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine T-bills average yields down.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine T-bills average yields down.

text.p: Average yields at auctions of six-month, nine-month and 12-month treasury bills fell from the last sales, a central bank statement said on Tuesday.
Six-month bills dropped to 19.64 from 20.20 percent, nine-month bills slipped to 27.81 from 28.14 percent, and 12-month bills edged down to 30.34 from 30.36 percent.
The results of the six-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 44.50 million UAH 22.50 million UAH
Amount sold 18.19 million UAH 19.01 million UAH
Actual amount raised 16.57 million UAH 17.27 million UAH
The central bank sold 181,889 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of six-month discount T-bills is scheduled for July 10.
The results of the nine-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 44.00 million UAH 15.50 million UAH
Amount sold 44.00 million UAH 15.50 million UAH
Actual amount raised 36.42 million UAH 12.80 million UAH
The central bank sold 440,000 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of nine-month discount T-bills is scheduled for July 10.
The results of the 12-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume no limit stated no limit stated
Amount sold 98.93 million UAH 35.08 million UAH
Actual amount raised 75.95 million UAH 26.92 million UAH
The central bank sold 989,346 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of 12-month discount T-bills is scheduled for July 10.
